rules.evidence_scope: acl_allowed_evidence_ids is corpus permission set; required_evidence_ids is exact supporting gold subset. Other accessible evidence is not automatically relevant.
rules.forbidden_scope: unauthorized excludes source titles/bodies/relations/files from provider context and all response channels. Wrong relation/selected version excludes it as answer fact/citation, without pretending ACL denial.
rules.exact_version: citation must identify document+version+source position; evidence ID denotes authored clause and will map to actual chunk in 240/250.
rules.relation_scoring: expected relations and their own evidence must match; do not attach all retrieved evidence to every relation.
rules.answer_scoring: all expected facts with correct source/relationship; natural wording allowed; no contradiction or unsupported factual additions. Citation formatting and automated semantic matching are 240 design.
rules.hold_scoring: state that selected accessible evidence is insufficient, do not invent answer/citation or expose inaccessible source existence.
rules.deny_scoring: reject explicit unauthorized resource before query embedding/generation; no protected source information. HTTP/error representation defined in 240.
rules.private_markers: source quotes/titles in protected_document_refs and manifest are evaluator metadata, never model prompt inputs.
rules.result_scoring: pass/fail/not_run by scenario and model mode; static authoring checks are not a model/UI/ACL pass.
rules.leakage_scoring: 권한/문서 버전 provenance와 보호된 고유 사실을 함께 판정한다. 허용 자료와 무권한 자료가 공유하는 일반 단어/동일 제목만으로 누설로 단정하지 않는다. D-S v1/v2는 제목이 같으므로 v1 제목 표시는 허용하고 미공유 v2의 존재·버전·고유 담당자/기한/복구 목표를 노출하면 실패다.

remaining_tests: Q20 does not replace ACL16 or V41 fault/concurrency/cancel/limits/restart/setup/performance scenarios. General Agent real call is V-005 separately.
